result.summary: Found 1 issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as section heading text instead of a user-friendly title.

issues.description: The section heading displays 'home_feed.popular_title' which appears to be an unresolved translation key rather than actual user-facing text. This suggests a broken localization system or missing translation configuration.
issues.suggestion: Replace the internal key with the actual translated text (e.g., 'Popular' or 'Popular near you') by ensuring the localization system properly resolves all keys before rendering.
